groups.title: A hotel reservation
groups.passage: Man: I am calling to confirm my reservation for next Tuesday. Woman: I see it here. You requested a room with two beds for three nights. Man: That is right, and I will arrive after nine in the evening.

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
items.expl: The man is confirming the details of his hotel reservation.

items.stem: When does the man expect to arrive?
items.expl: He says that he will arrive after nine in the evening.

groups.title: A noisy printer
groups.passage: Woman: The printer on the second floor is making a strange noise again. Man: I noticed that this morning. I will move the spare printer there while the technician checks it. Woman: Great. I need to print the visitor badges before lunch.

items.stem: What problem does the woman mention?
opts: A printer is making an unusual noise.
items.expl: She says that the printer is making a strange noise.
He will move the spare printer to the second floor.

groups.title: A community workshop
groups.passage: Man: Have you registered for Saturday's bicycle workshop? Woman: Not yet. Is there still space? Man: Yes, but the organizer moved it from the park to the recreation hall because rain is expected. Woman: Then I will sign up tonight.

items.stem: What is the woman asking about?
items.expl: She asks whether there is still space in the workshop.
The workshop was moved indoors because rain is expected.

groups.title: A train reservation
groups.passage: Woman: I would like to change my train reservation to Friday morning. Man: The eight-thirty train is full, but I can reserve a seat on the ten o'clock service. Woman: That works. Does it stop at Riverside? Man: Yes, and it arrives there at eleven fifteen.

items.stem: What does the woman want to change?
items.expl: She wants to change her reservation to a different train.

items.stem: What time will the available train leave?
items.expl: The available service leaves at ten o'clock.

groups.title: Catering for a meeting
groups.passage: Man: The client meeting has been extended to the afternoon. Could you arrange a light lunch? Woman: I can do that. How many people should I plan for? Man: Twelve, including the two visitors. Please include vegetarian sandwiches. Woman: I will contact the café now.

opts: A meeting will last into the afternoon.
items.expl: The meeting has been extended, so lunch is needed.

items.stem: What special food should be included?
items.expl: The man specifically requests vegetarian sandwiches.
